entities.summary: Patriarch of the Israelites and spiritual father of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. Called by God from Ur of the Chaldees to Canaan (c. 2000 BCE), Abraham's covenant — including circumcision and the promise of descendants as numerous as the stars — is the bedrock of Abrahamic monotheism.
